notes.title: CameraBag 2025.1: new Color Mask tool, expanded Split Tone adjustment, and more!
notes.notes:
We’re pleased to announce that CameraBag 2025.1 has been released (Photo and Pro), bringing several usability improvements - the Split Tone and Hue Shift adjustments have been expanded, and a new easy-to-use Color Mask tool has been added!

CameraBag’s Masks section continues to grow with a new Color Mask tool. You can easily select the color range you want to edit using a simple color dropper tool (and falloff sliders), then do things like make only the sky darker, or make just the trees greener. An improved Split Tone adjustment gives you tremendously expanded editing possibilities with the addition of the Color Method dropdown (essentially different blend mode algorithms).

We’ve also added a Simple mode to the Hue Shift adjustment, and added copy/paste support to all color choosers so you can easily exactly match colors across adjustments. Plus bug fixes!

[previewyoutube=_ZS-51PZ0Sk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: CameraBag 2024.3 is here!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the release of CameraBag 2024.3 (Photo and Pro), which contains tons of new features and workflow improvements including noise removal, chroma keying, photo/video flipping, a new color picker, and more! Grab the update and check out the video below for details on how it works (and upgrade for a discounted price if it's been more than a year since you last purchased CameraBag)!

We really don’t like generative AI in photo editing, but we’ve continued to add support for useful, compact, locally-run AI models with our new AI Denoise command (alongside our existing AI Upscale command). Just click on the button to remove excess analog and digital noise, including unwanted low-light grain and image compression artifacts.

Additionally we’ve added a bunch of new features like the ability to flip your photos and videos horizontally or vertically. CameraBag’s rotate, flip, and crop tools make reconfiguring your media for any site or device amazingly simple, especially when it comes to videos. Another handy video feature is the ability to open a video frame in a new tab and edit it as a photo, without having to first save out and then reload a video frame. Check the full feature list below for more!

[previewyoutube=p2ZG5LCyyrI;full][/previewyoutube]

Updates list:
- Added new AI Denoise function to remove digital and analog noise from photos
- Added horizontal and vertical flip commands for photos (and videos in CameraBag Pro)
- Added color picker tool to all color choosers, for easily picking colors from images 
- Added Chroma Key adjustment to remove colored backgrounds
- Improved support for high-bit-depth videos (CameraBag Pro only)
- Added command to open video frame as an image in a new tab (CameraBag Pro only)
- Added exact pixel dimension option for Fill Border
- Added more fixed zoom levels
- Added clip indicators to histogram
- Fixed an issue causing CameraBag to not run on some Windows 11 systems
- Fixed issues with video rotation on Windows
- Various other bug fixes and performance improvements

notes.title: CameraBag 2024.2 is here — keyboard shortcut editing and musical slides!
notes.notes:
CameraBag 2024.2 is here! For this release we’ve added the ability to customize your keyboard shortcuts via the new Shortcut Editor. You can find it in Edit > Edit Keyboard Shortcuts. Simply select a command and then press the shortcut you’d like to use. You can also easily reset to defaults or clear out any shortcut.

We’ve also added the ability to add audio tracks to your slideshows, found in File > Create Slideshow. You now have the option to select an audio (or video) file to use as a sound source. You can also set the slideshow to be the length of the song. We’ve added a new alphabetical sorting option for slideshow images as well!

[previewyoutube=02thcdguXkc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: CameraBag 2024.1 released with fast, local, unlimited AI upscaling!
notes.notes:
We’re very excited to announce that CameraBag 2024.1 has been released, and includes a powerful and extremely useful new tool: AI upscaling! Grab the update and check out the video below for details on how it works (and upgrade for a discounted price if it's been more than a year since you last purchased CameraBag)!

Ever have an image that looks great but is simply too low-resolution? CameraBag 2024.1 has you covered with its new AI upscaling feature. This is one of those places where AI really can work magic, filling in details that don’t exist in the original as it creates a much higher-resolution version of your image. CameraBag’s upscaling works great on all kinds of images, from photos to paintings to stills from your favorite anime.

To upscale your image in CameraBag, simply press the “AI Upscale (4X)” button at the top of the Adjustments tab, or in the Edit menu. This will make a version of your image that is 4 times the original resolution in each dimension (maxing out at 10K pixels per side). It can be especially handy on crops, since cropping inherently reduces image resolution. Just make your crop, hit the upscale button, and voila: a super high-resolution crop.

Say goodbye to all those sites that want you to pay a subscription fee for a limited number of photo upscales - CameraBag’s AI upscaler runs locally on your computer (no uploading), and lets you upscale as many images as you want using the magic of the AI.

[previewyoutube=fVmrJVNG7Tk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: CameraBag 2021.1 is ready!
notes.notes:
[b]This update includes the brand-new Lens Flare adjustment, a whole new set of presets ("Summer Flares"), and more![/b]

Some of the new things in v2021.1 include:

[list]
[*] New Lens Flare adjustment! Hit Remix to generate endless variations, and position with the on-screen controls.
[*] New Summer Flares presets, with some of our favorite lens flare variations alongside other filter effects.
[*] Vignette, Spot Mask, and other adjustments with a location can now be positioned off-image.
[*] Bug fixes and speed improvements.
[/list]

We've made a video showcasing some of these new features here:
[previewyoutube=zE_tIHg7wWI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: CameraBag 2021 is now live! Now featuring color management!
notes.notes:
New update includes color management, speed improvements, bug fixes, and more!

Some of the new things in v2021.0 include:
[list]
[*] Full color management workflow for photos (CameraBag Pro) and automatic sRGB workflow for photos (CameraBag Photo). Set the default behavior in preferences, and override it at any time with the new Color Space tile.
[*] Speed improvements when exporting video files (Pro)
[*] Fixed crashing bug when previewing video files on Windows (Pro)
[*] Fixed video loading on files with non-square pixel aspect ratios on Windows (Pro)
[*] Fixed photo orientation bug on Windows
[/list]

We've made a video showcasing some of these new features at: youtu.be/Ax6AsA4KZTs

notes.title: CameraBag 2020.2 out now, adds favorite filters
notes.notes:
We've got a new update for CameraBag users! This one adds the ability to favorite your most-used filters (click the star next to a filter name) and they'll be added to an easy-access list at the top. More info is available over on our blog: https://nevercenter.com/blog/index.php?pid=42

Happy editing!

notes.title: Released!
notes.notes:
CameraBag Pro is now available on Steam! If you already own CameraBag Photo on steam, you should receive a copy of Pro automatically in your library. We hope you enjoy. 

Also, please let us know if there are any immediate issues, as sometimes problems arise right after a launch. Thanks!
